method: For each baked upper quad / lower triangle, intersect their plan polygons and evaluate the two affine planes at every overlap polygon vertex. The minimum is exact for this pair of planar meshes. Uses the TS evaluator actual <=3m mesh segments and slab envelope width=asphalt width+3m (1.5m each side). Terrain gap is an independent dense 0.5m sample, not proof between samples.
